title: Review: gap vs 20-day range -> close above yesterday's high
body: CONFIRMED, but no new information. No look-ahead; same pattern in both halves (10% of days in the smallest-gap fifth close above yesterday's high vs 64% in the biggest-gap fifth). It is mechanical (a big gap up opens near yesterday's high) and a near-copy of power #7; where the open sits inside yesterday's range predicts the same thing better (walk-forward log-loss 0.507 vs 0.568) and this ratio adds nothing to it.

title: Review: big London range -> bigger first NY hour
body: CONFIRMED. No look-ahead; identical in 2014-19 and 2020-25 (first-hour range 0.46x of the normal day range in the quietest-London fifth vs 0.76x in the busiest). This is volatility clustering: the whole overnight range already predicts it as well; London adds about 1% on top of overnight + yesterday's range. Good for expecting a wide first hour, says nothing about direction.

title: Weekly reflection - 8 Nov 2026
body: Reading was thin this week: only 3 new papers entered the library (all on AI agents or sentiment in markets, relevance 1-2 of 5, none testable on Volta's data yet). The engine tested 54 ideas (week 45): 31 not confirmed, 20 failed to translate or run, 1 unfit and 2 promising - a 4% hit rate, in line with week 44 (1 of 58). Both promising items were Volta's own questions and both are now CONFIRMED, but as base-rate facts rather than edges: a big gap vs the normal range predicts closing above yesterday's high (a near-copy of power #7), and a busy London session predicts a wide first NY hour (volatility clustering the overnight range already captures). No wishes for Claude were open this week; the newest ones repeat earlier ones (5-minute GEX rank series asked 3 times and blocked - no intraday options data; temperature scaling asked 3 times and frozen with the live side), so repeated asks should be merged rather than re-filed. The next useful step is not more questions about the open but a new family or data source with enough trades to give the power test a chance.
